title: EEG Moments Dataset (EMD)
description: The EEG Moments Dataset (EMD) contains EEG responses from 6 subjects viewing 1,102 three-second naturalistic videos presented with their audio tracks. Each subject viewed the 1,000-video training set 6 times and the 102-video test set 24 times. Eye-tracking data (gaze and pupil size) were recorded concurrently. The videos carry human annotations (objects, scenes, actions, sentence descriptions, transcriptions, memorability). EMD is the EEG companion to the BOLD Moments fMRI dataset and supports studies of dynamic visual event processing.
methods_description: EEG and eye-tracking data were recorded while subjects viewed 3-second videos with audio over multiple sessions and runs, instructed to maintain central fixation. Raw data are in BIDS format, with preprocessed EEG, preprocessed eye-tracking and stimulus metadata provided as derivatives.
